routes.label: at a passport office in Sudan

note: The fees set when the Ministry of the Interior resumed issuing passports in nine states, as Dabanga reported on 3 September 2023: 150,000 Sudanese pounds for an adult and 75,000 for a child (taken as under 18). A review was ordered; no later official fee was found, so these are the latest. Validity and time aren't read.

sources.title: Dabanga, Sudan passport fees hike 'blackmail' (3 September 2023)
sources.said: The increase in Sudanese passport issuance fees, now set at SDG150,000 for adults and SDG75,000 for children, has been widely criticised by a significant portion of the population. Sudan’s Ministry of Interior Affairs announced the resumption of passport issuance and the restoration of civil registry and traffic data in nine states on Wednesday. ... In response, Chairman of the Sovereignty Council and Commander-in-Chief of the army Lt Gen Abdelfattah El Burhan directed the police to review the Sudanese passport fees, considering the “circumstances of citizens”.
